title: High latency due to downstream dependency timeout
summary: When a service shows a latency spike correlated with a recent deploy to a dependency, check the dependency's connection pool and recent deploy first before restarting the alerting service itself.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion
summary: Connection pool exhaustion is usually resolved by scaling out replicas or rolling back a recent deploy that increased per-request connection usage.

title: Out of memory kills
summary: OOM kills are typically resolved with a pod restart plus a memory limit increase if recurring.

title: Elevated error rate without deploy correlation
summary: Elevated error rate with no recent deploy usually points to an external dependency or infrastructure issue outside the service's own deploy history.
